patthana11.8:1.1: na kusalaṃ na hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.8:2.1: na kusalaṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.8:3.1: na kusalaṃ na paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika namicchattattikaṃ
patthana11.8:4.1: na kusalaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.8:5.1: na kusalaṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattikana maggārammaṇattikaṃ
patthana11.8:6.1: na kusalaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana11.8:8.1: na kusalaṃ na anuppannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na uppādiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattikana atītattikaṃ
patthana11.8:9.1: na kusalaṃ na atītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na anāgataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattikana atītārammaṇattikaṃ
patthana11.8:10.1: na kusalaṃ na atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika naajjhattattikaṃ
patthana11.8:11.1: na kusalaṃ na ajjhattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na bahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika naajjhattārammaṇattikaṃ
patthana11.8:12.1: na kusalaṃ na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika
